_about: Curated list for oneui-smooth. Only packages listed here are ever offered for disabling, and only if they are installed on the phone. Every change is 'pm disable-user' (reversible). PRs welcome: add the package, what it does, which feature breaks, and the device/One UI version you verified it on.

questions.bixby: Do you use Bixby at all (voice assistant, Bixby key, Bixby Vision)?
questions.bixby_voice: Do you wake Bixby by saying "Hi Bixby"?
questions.games: Do you play games on this phone and use Game Booster / Gaming Hub?
questions.smartthings: Do you use SmartThings, a Galaxy Watch, Galaxy Buds or a SmartTag?
questions.samsung_pass: Do you use Samsung Pass to save passwords or sign in to apps?
questions.samsung_cloud: Do you back up or sync (e.g. Samsung Notes, Gallery) with Samsung Cloud?
questions.link_windows: Do you use Link to Windows / Phone Link with a Windows PC?
questions.samsung_free: Do you use Samsung Free / Samsung News (the panel left of the home screen)?
questions.kids: Does anyone use Samsung Kids on this phone?
questions.smart_switch: Will you move to a new phone with Smart Switch soon?
questions.ar: Do you use AR Emoji, AR Zone or AR Doodle?
questions.google_meet: Do you use Google Meet (video calls)?
questions.google_tv: Do you use the Google TV app?
questions.ai_suggest: Disable Samsung's on-device suggestion engine (app/action suggestions)? Check that app-drawer search still works afterwards.

packages.name: Facebook App Manager
packages.what: Preinstalled Facebook updater. Runs even if you never installed Facebook.

packages.name: Facebook App Installer
packages.what: Preinstalled Facebook installer. (The Facebook app still installs and works from the Play Store.)

packages.name: Samsung diagnostics agent
packages.note: Persistent on some models (One UI 9): it may keep running even when disabled. Harmless either way.

packages.name: Knox analytics uploader
packages.what: Uploads Knox usage analytics. Knox security itself is not affected.

packages.name: Device Quality Agent
packages.what: Collects device quality / usage statistics for Samsung.

packages.name: Samsung Members
packages.what: Samsung community + feedback app. You lose the Members app and its error-report tool.

packages.name: Netflix preload activation
packages.what: Partner service for the preinstalled Netflix deal. The Netflix app keeps working.

packages.name: Glance lock screen
packages.what: Lock screen content/ads feed (India and some other regions).

packages.name: Bixby voice wake-up
packages.question: bixby_voice
packages.what: Always-listening "Hi Bixby" detector. Bixby still opens from the side key without it.

packages.name: Gaming Hub
packages.question: games
packages.what: Game launcher; also runs a background notification process.

packages.name: SmartThings
packages.question: smartthings
packages.what: SmartThings, also used to set up Galaxy Watch/Buds/SmartTag.

packages.name: Galaxy Wearable stub
packages.question: smartthings
packages.what: Installer stub for the Galaxy Wearable app.

packages.name: Samsung Pass
packages.question: samsung_pass
packages.check_after: If you use Samsung Wallet, open it and make sure payments still load.

packages.name: Samsung Cloud
packages.question: samsung_cloud
packages.what: Samsung backup/sync. Samsung Notes stops syncing to the cloud (notes stay on the phone).

packages.name: Link to Windows
packages.question: link_windows
packages.what: Phone Link companion. Keeps running (and reading notifications) even when switched off in Settings.

packages.name: Samsung Free / Samsung News
packages.question: samsung_free
packages.what: Content panel left of the home screen.

packages.name: Smart Switch agent
packages.question: smart_switch
packages.what: Smart Switch background agent. Re-enable it before you transfer to a new phone.

packages.name: Smart Suggestions
packages.question: ai_suggest
packages.what: On-device suggestion engine (app/action suggestions). Uses 150-340 MB on One UI 9.
packages.check_after: Open the app drawer and search for an app. If search breaks, run undo.

packages.name: Customization Service
packages.question: ai_suggest
packages.what: Learns your usage patterns to feed suggestions.

goodlock_systemui_plugins.name: LockStar
goodlock_systemui_plugins.note: Measured alone on a Galaxy A36: no measurable cost.

goodlock_systemui_plugins.name: NotiStar
goodlock_systemui_plugins.note: Runs inside System UI and reads every notification.

goodlock_background_modules.name: Display Assistant
goodlock_background_modules.note: Runs in the background and reads every notification.

goodlock_background_modules.name: GoodCatch / NiceCatch
goodlock_background_modules.note: Watches notifications/system events in the background.

listener_labels.com.sec.android.app.launcher: Samsung home screen (app icon badges) - keep

sleep_rules._about: Matched against package names (substring, case-insensitive). First matching category wins.

never_sleep.why: Needs to receive messages, payments, OTPs or stay connected in real time.

sleeping.why: Used regularly but nothing urgent: can refresh now and then, no need to run all the time.
